snippet.title: Teaser Trailer - Severed Chains 3.0
snippet.description:
Donate to support Severed Chains: https://ko-fi.com/monoxide
Donate to support LoD services: https://ko-fi.com/drewniverse

Severed Chains version 3.0 releases this week! This video includes a quick, flashy rundown of some key features. It also showcases a sampling of mods that will be available separately, and the release date of SC 3.0.

Today's Article: https://legendofdragoon.org/news/sc3-release-preview
Learn about SC: https://legendofdragoon.org/projects/severed-chains/

Severed Chains is a revised game engine that runs Legend of Dragoon at its full potential. The program does not include LoD or any of its copyrighted assets. Users must provide a legal, digitized copy of the PS1 game; otherwise Severed Chains will not run.
